stem:
A student investigates the discharge of capacitors in the circuit shown in Fig. 2.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The capacitors have capacitances *C*ₚ and $C_Q$.

The student closes the switch to charge the capacitors and then records the maximum reading *V*₀ on the voltmeter.

The switch is opened and a stop-watch is started. The capacitors discharge through the resistor and the reading on the voltmeter decreases. When the reading on the voltmeter is *V* the time *t* is recorded. The discharge of the capacitors is repeated and the mean time *T* is calculated.

The experiment is repeated for different values of *C*ₚ and $C_Q$.

For each combination of *C*ₚ and $C_Q$, the combined capacitance *C* is calculated.

It is suggested that *C* and *T* are related by the equation

$\ln\left(\frac{V}{V_0}\right) = -\frac{T}{CR}$

where *R* is the resistance of the resistor.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A graph is plotted of *T* on the y-axis against *C* on the x-axis.

Determine an expression for the gradient.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Values of *C*ₚ, $C_Q$ and *t* are given in Table 2.1.

[[fig:f2]]

The relationship between *C*, *C*ₚ and $C_Q$ is

$C = \frac{C_P C_Q}{C_P + C_Q}$.

Calculate and record values of *C* / 10⁻⁴ F and *T* / s in Table 2.1. Include the absolute uncertainties in *T*.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Plot a graph of *T* / s against *C* / 10⁻⁴ F. Include error bars for *T*.

[[fig:f3]]

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable straight line on your graph. Label both lines.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the gradient of the line of best fit. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The values of *V*₀ and *V* are:

*V*₀ = (4.8 ± 0.1) V

*V* = (2.4 ± 0.1) V.

Calculate $\ln\left(\frac{V}{V_0}\right)$. Include the absolute uncertainty in $\ln\left(\frac{V}{V_0}\right)$.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: Using your answers to (a), (c)(iii) and (d), determine the value of *R*. Include an appropriate unit.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: The experiment is repeated. Determine the value of *C* that gives a value of *T* of 60.0 s. Include the absolute uncertainty in your answer.
